newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 13-day securities repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 13-day securities repo tender.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it was setting a tender for 13-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed three percent rate.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Thursday and the securities have to be repurchased on December 4. The allotment will be announced tomorrow.
A 68.9 billion mark facility set at a fixed interest rate of 3.00 percent expires on Thursday. A 14-day facility set last week carried an interest rate of 3.00 percent.
Wednesday is a holiday in some parts of Germany.
